goal: Test coverage gate: changed code must be tested before it merges.
use: Test coverage gate: changed code must be tested before it merges. Use when a change adds or modifies code.

steps.note: Measure coverage on the changed lines, not only the total.
Set the rule. New code below the agreed threshold blocks the merge.
Check meaningful tests. Flag coverage that comes from tests with no assertions.
Check exclusions. Each excluded path needs a reason.
Report. The changed lines, the coverage and any gap.
